_comment: Battle Mode (S9c): fight after fight with no map, read by fight/battle_mode/battle_mode_tuning.gd. Every number is a first guess for S10 to tune. See data/battle_mode/README.md.
_lengths_comment: How long a run lasts. fights: 0 is endless (until the squad falls). boss_fights: fight numbers that are boss fights; boss_every: also every Nth fight (0 none).

gauntlet.name: Gauntlet
gauntlet.description: Ten fights. Bosses at fight 5 and fight 10.

endless.name: Endless
endless.description: Fight until the squad falls. A boss every fifth fight.

_squads_comment: Preset squads: a draft seed (BotFactory, the same draft the New Run screen shows for that seed) and the draft positions (0-based) fielded. kit (optional): combat action ids every fielded bot holds instead of its drafted skills (Strike and Wait are always there). The first preset is the default. TODO(decision: battle-mode-default-squad): the Rework kit, so the rework's verbs show up in the metrics.

squads.name: Vanguard
squads.description: Two heavy hitters and a sturdy frame.

squads.name: Bulwark
squads.description: High HP and Defense, slow to act.

_tiers_comment: Enemy tiers from weakest to strongest; an elite fight shifts each listed tier up one step.
_fast_speed_comment: An enemy at or above this Speed counts as fast for a curve row's 'fast'.
_elite_every_comment: Every Nth fight that is not a boss fight is an elite fight (0: none).
_archetypes_from_fight_comment: Enemies that name an archetype (Charger, Plated, Scaler, ...) join every pool from this fight on, whatever their faction.
_curve_comment: Each row applies from fight from_fight until the next row. count: enemies fielded. types: distinct enemy kinds among them (more questions at once). factions: distinct factions they come from ('generic' is the roster with no faction). tiers: the tiers drawn from. fast: how many of the kinds must be fast. hp/attack/defense_percent: stat scaling, kept close to the squad's growth. speed_bonus: added to every enemy's Speed. defense_level: the FightRequest level (sets nothing in Battle Mode but the grid cost line).
_endless_growth_comment: Past the last row: every 'every' fights, add these to its numbers (count and types up to their max, speed_bonus up to its max).
_elite_comment: An elite fight: tiers one step up, extra_types more kinds (within the row's count), and these stats (percent of the row's).
_boss_comment: A boss fight: the next boss in order (the list repeats), its stats at these percents of the row's scaling, with 'escorts' enemies drawn as a normal fight of the row.
_metrics_comment: dominant_share_percent: an action above this share of a fight's squad decisions is flagged (the plan's 'no action above about 50%'). csv_folder: where played and simulated runs append fights.csv and runs.csv (not the save or settings).
